schema_note: Portable archive schema only; not an asserted native EOS schema.

records.statement: Prepare a request for management approval, not an implementation-completion report.
records.rationale_or_limit: The user needs a report for the boss; no signed approval appears in the thread.

records.statement: Keep the approval narrative in English, short and understandable to a non-technical manager.
records.rationale_or_limit: Explain the main idea, practical effectiveness, advantages, disadvantages and examples.

records.statement: Provide the same approval narrative in .md and .docx, with a separate dynamic Excel plan.
records.rationale_or_limit: Excel owns changing assumptions; the narrative owns the stable idea and approval criteria.

records.statement: Keep Option C: Hardware-Agnostic Telematics Hub, limited to reusable Vehicle Status.
records.rationale_or_limit: No switch to another Automotive idea and no universal gateway expansion.

records.statement: Use the existing AAOS PoC as the starting implementation and primary runtime baseline.
records.rationale_or_limit: Its existence is not proof of buildability, clean architecture or portability.

records.statement: Use a lightweight deterministic runner executing the same core for tests and CI only.
records.rationale_or_limit: No separate Linux product deployment and no duplicate reimplementation of the core.

records.statement: Keep Android, OEM vocabulary, cloud SDK/payload and storage implementation types outside the core.
records.rationale_or_limit: Project-owned contracts separate shared behavior from integration details.

records.statement: Permit recovery/refactoring changes, then freeze behavior and govern exceptional post-freeze changes.
records.rationale_or_limit: A zero-change requirement does not prohibit the initial extraction; later changes require review and regression evidence.

records.statement: Demonstrate A and B mappings, with B allowed to be deterministic/injected or controlled.
records.rationale_or_limit: No second live OEM integration is assumed in the pilot.

records.statement: Preserve units, quality, timestamps and semantic basis; reject unsupported equivalence.
records.rationale_or_limit: Missing is not zero; a unit conversion is not a license to equate different battery-charge definitions.

records.statement: Use MQTT/TLS as the primary connection and HTTPS/TLS as the replacement.
records.rationale_or_limit: Preserve data, publish decisions, IDs and outcome meaning; do not invent equivalent subscription capabilities.

records.statement: A shared controlled backend with two protocols proves protocol substitution only.
records.rationale_or_limit: Independent cloud-vendor portability needs a separately evidenced integration.

records.statement: Generate one immutable status identity and retain its envelope and ID through queueing and retry.
records.rationale_or_limit: Retry is not a new publish trigger; protocol packet IDs are not application status IDs.

records.statement: Separate transport acceptance from the declared receiver application-confirmation step.
records.rationale_or_limit: Do not delete a retained record as delivered before the approved receipt condition.

records.statement: Use bounded durable retention, declared overflow/expiry and observable retries, losses and duplicates.
records.rationale_or_limit: No unlimited storage, zero-loss or exactly-once transport claim.

records.statement: Read vehicle status only; expose no actuator/write path for this capability.
records.rationale_or_limit: This internal pilot is not approval for vehicle control.

records.statement: Allow only TELEMETRY_PROFILE_UPDATE, with authorization, target, freshness, replay, schema and range checks.
records.rationale_or_limit: Apply valid changes atomically; keep remote configuration disabled until the required checks pass.

records.statement: Periodic, material-change and first-valid-snapshot are the proposed three triggers.
records.rationale_or_limit: The source required three triggers without fully defining them; these must be reconciled or approved at Gate B.

records.statement: Retain numerical schema, queue, freshness, profile and command limits as proposed starting values only.
records.rationale_or_limit: No operating measurements or approved production sizing substantiate these defaults.

records.statement: Retain S1-S6 operational definitions for meaning, policy, replacement, recovery, security and integrated reuse.
records.rationale_or_limit: Definitions require approval; the thread contains no actual test-pass evidence.

records.statement: Request recovery funding first; use Gate A to continue, reduce scope or stop.
records.rationale_or_limit: Do not automatically release full-project funding.

records.statement: A reduced demo shows mapping A to core to MQTT/TLS to receiver receipt.
records.rationale_or_limit: It is not full reuse acceptance; remote settings remain off and crash durability is not claimed before S4.

records.statement: Keep AAOS SDV design readiness separate from actual target runtime validation.
records.rationale_or_limit: A porting design, host result or source assumption cannot establish runtime support.

records.statement: Exclude production certification, independent assurance, production PKI/HSM guarantees and untested platform support.
records.rationale_or_limit: Internal checks by the implementation team are not independent security assurance.

records.statement: Make total developers and junior count editable; derive experienced count and update the forecast.
records.rationale_or_limit: The prior fixed two-person constraint is now the default scenario, not a permanent headcount lock.

records.statement: Model mentoring and junior ramp-up; reserve critical technical decisions for experienced developers.
records.rationale_or_limit: Junior capacity cannot be substituted blindly for experienced critical work; no hidden specialist team is assumed.

records.statement: Use sequential phases, contributor/critical-role caps, minimum duration, waits and upward rounding.
records.rationale_or_limit: Additional staff do not automatically produce a proportional schedule reduction.

records.statement: At the saved 1 experienced + 1 junior defaults, forecast recovery W2, core W5, demo W8, pilot W18, reserve W20.
records.rationale_or_limit: The old 8-week full-MVP plan is superseded; dates and approvals remain unset.

records.statement: Distinguish 828 planned expert/support work hours from 1,440 default allocated staffed hours.
records.rationale_or_limit: Do not label either as actual completed work or directly compare accepted-work hours with an old nominal staffing estimate.

records.statement: Leave unentered money inputs as NOT SET; price only explicit rates and costs.
records.rationale_or_limit: Blank does not mean free. Full cost includes recovery once; reserve is additional and needs release.

records.statement: Leave reuse value NOT QUANTIFIED until comparable effort, incremental setup, maintenance, adoption and evidence are entered.
records.rationale_or_limit: Forecast effort savings are not realized cash savings, ROI or revenue.

records.statement: The report illustrates 80 h without reuse, 40 h with reuse, 160 extra setup h and 40 maintenance h: break-even at 5 later integrations.
records.rationale_or_limit: These figures are not live business-case inputs, measured savings or project estimates.

records.statement: Require a named consuming team, comparable work measurement and a reproducible handover.
records.rationale_or_limit: A successful upload and a reuse percentage alone do not establish practical return.

records.statement: Keep I2-I7 as considered alternatives, not concurrent projects.
records.rationale_or_limit: I2 can be a better early-value choice; the user retained I1 for this approval request.

records.statement: Prefer E3 AAOS-first controlled extraction after selecting I1.
records.rationale_or_limit: E1 is demo-speed comparator; E2 adds Linux scope; E4 depends on actual SDV target access and fit.

records.statement: Check existing platform/library overlap and avoid rebuilding a broker, simulator or generic platform unnecessarily.
records.rationale_or_limit: Existing ecosystem context in older files is historical reference, not newly verified in this export.

records.statement: Excel recalculates resources and management outputs; Markdown and Word do not rewrite themselves.
records.rationale_or_limit: Preserve a dated approved workbook when a decision actually occurs.

records.statement: The workbook models one team from the start, not actual progress, joining dates or a holiday calendar.
records.rationale_or_limit: Changing a forecast is not a hiring decision, test pass or approval; rebaseline an in-flight project explicitly.

records.statement: Re-estimate after recovery and when critical work, access, availability or actual throughput diverges.
records.rationale_or_limit: Reduce optional scope, release authorized reserve or change the schedule; do not weaken full-acceptance evidence silently.

records.statement: Preserve the thread ideas, decisions and every available source/report version for EOS.
records.rationale_or_limit: Keep current sources separate from superseded history; copying a package is not proof of EOS ingestion.
